payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Place a frog in the toilet bowl; distinguish this from frogs elsewhere on the toilet or nearby.
outcome.target: A recognizable frog visibly located within the toilet bowl.
outcome.reference: The toilet bowl in the source image.

check.question: Is a recognizable frog visibly inside the toilet bowl?
check.complete_when: At least one recognizable frog is visibly within the bowl.
check.partial_when: A frog is present in the toilet area, but none is clearly inside the bowl.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to the toilet area.
check.unknown_when: The bowl or frog placement cannot be assessed reliably.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A recognizable green frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby."}

parsed.evidence: A recognizable green frog is visibly inside the toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby.
